import FreeCAD as App, Part, Sketcher
doc = App.ActiveDocument or App.newDocument("Outline")
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
xz = [o for o in body.Origin.OutList if o.Role == "XZ_Plane"][0]
sk = body.newObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")
sk.AttachmentSupport = (xz, [""])
sk.MapMode = "FlatFace"
doc.recompute()
pts = [(0,0),(25,0),(25,10),(20,10),(20,5),(5,5),(5,60),(0,60)]
V = App.Vector
n = len(pts)
for i in range(n):
    a, b = pts[i], pts[(i+1) % n]
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0],a[1],0), V(b[0],b[1],0)))
for i in range(n):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", i, 2, (i+1) % n, 1))
doc.recompute()
pad = body.newObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 20
doc.recompute()
print(sk.Shape.isClosed(), pad.Shape.Volume, pad.Shape.BoundBox)

import FreeCAD as App
doc = App.ActiveDocument
s = doc.getObject("Pad").Shape
bb = s.BoundBox
print("Doc:", doc.Name)
print("Tree:")
for o in doc.Objects:
    print(" ", o.Name, o.TypeId, "| label:", o.Label, "| parent:", [p.Name for p in o.InList])
print("BBox: X %.3f Y %.3f Z %.3f" % (bb.XLength, bb.YLength, bb.ZLength))
print("Volume %.3f  Area %.3f" % (s.Volume, s.Area))
print("CoM", s.CenterOfMass)
print("Faces/Edges/Verts", len(s.Faces), len(s.Edges), len(s.Vertexes))
print("Valid", s.isValid(), "Solid", s.ShapeType)
sk = doc.getObject("Sketch")
for i,g in enumerate(sk.Geometry):
    print("Line", i, g.StartPoint, "->", g.EndPoint, "len %.2f" % g.length())
print("Perimeter", sum(g.length() for g in sk.Geometry))
print("Pad:", doc.getObject("Pad").Length, doc.getObject("Pad").Type)
